BiblicalUsage: I have broken the bands of your yoke, says the LORD, and made you go upright. The word is the elevation, the going erect — slaves standing straight for the first time.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God broke the bands of the yoke so his people could walk upright, and that is what redemption looks like.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
